blurb: La Barberie is a cooperative microbrewery established in 1997, brewing distinctive quality beers. They offer a full-time restaurant and catering service with experienced kitchen staff. Guests can enjoy beers on their terrace in the Saint-Roch neighborhood, with family and dogs welcome year-round.
